column1: # One thing of a shop, as Phiegg's item page has it (puikit:
# `thing` (data/form.tsv, part/shop/thing.rs). Its tabs, in order: each
# its key, its icon, and the lists of the form it holds; its word
# `thing.<key>` of data/text.tsv. A tab with nothing in it is not shown.
# The figures of the stats tab, in order: each its key (its word
# `thing.stat.<key>`) and how it is had: the price; from Phiegg's ledger
# of it (its sales) how many of an event, the last price, the highest,
# the lowest, the average, how many have held it, when it was first and
# last sold. A figure with nothing to say is not shown.
# Which of Phiegg's records are a thing's sales: the kind, the field
# naming the thing, who it went from and to, its price, when, and what
# happened (a sale, a transfer, an offer; `thing.event.<it>` its word).
